title: Inbox config (v1)
description: Optional settings document at config/inbox. Without it the page uses owner keys as labels and treats "me" as the viewer.

self.description: The owner key whose items count as "yours" by default. Each viewer can override it on the page.

owners.description: Owners in the order the page groups them. Labels are display text.

locale.description: UI language. auto follows the browser.
